name: eagle
notes: A bald eagle: white head, dark body, circling high and alone over the slopes and the coast. Now and then it sits a while on the top of the tallest tree near. When it is hungry it stoops on what it eats in the open below it, a gull in the air or on the sea, a duck, a rabbit, a fish near the surface, and takes it or misses; a kill goes off in its talons, to a tree top if there is one.
